name: Multi-loss APGD + ODI + targeted
tagline: 15 untargeted restarts cycling CE/DLR/CW with cosine $\alpha$, ODI init, neighborhood-smoothed momentum, then up to 30 targeted restarts on still-correct samples; keeps best-margin adv per sample.
init_recovers: MI-FGSM at single-loss, no smoothing, no targeted phase
diff_from_baseline: Combines AutoAttack-style multi-loss (CE+DLR+CW) restarts and targeted top-$k$ rounds with MI-FGSM-style smoothed momentum, ODI initialization, and per-sample best-margin tracking — far beyond the single-restart PGD/MI-FGSM/FGSM baselines and unlike the AutoAttack baseline by adding ODI init and Gaussian-smoothed gradients.

name: Nesterov + CE+CW hybrid + restarts
tagline: Nesterov-look-ahead PGD with cosine α, gradient normalized by $\ell_1$ mean, momentum 0.95, and a CE + 2×CW margin hybrid loss; 4 restarts with per-sample best score.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_margin
key_hyperparams.role: weight on CW margin in hybrid loss

init_recovers: Closer to MI-FGSM at λ_margin=0 and decay=1.0; PGD at decay=0
diff_from_baseline: Adds Nesterov look-ahead and a hybrid CE + 2×margin loss to MI-FGSM-style momentum-PGD, with cosine-decayed α and 4 random restarts selecting the per-sample maximum — none of these features appear in the FGSM, PGD, MI-FGSM, or AutoAttack baselines individually.

name: AutoAttack-style restart cascade (broken)
tagline: Plans CE/CW/DLR + 5 targeted-CW + 5 targeted-DLR restarts of cosine-schedule MI-FGSM, but the function references undefined `is_adv` and crashes at runtime.
diff_from_baseline: Intends an AutoAttack-style cascade (CE+CW+DLR+targeted variants) on top of MI-FGSM-style cosine-α momentum-PGD, but as written the code uses an undefined `is_adv` flag and crashes. In effect it returns the clean images and counts as 0% success, well below FGSM/PGD/MI-FGSM/AutoAttack baselines.

name: Multi-loss APGD + targeted top-k
tagline: Compact APGD-style loop with CE+DLR+log-softmax untargeted phase, then top-$k$ targeted attacks (loss = $1.2\,(z_t-z_y)/\text{denom}+0.35\,\text{DLR}+0.35\log p_t$) restarted from best, finishing with a refinement at $\alpha=\epsilon/8$.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the simple PGD/MI-FGSM single-loss attack with a multi-loss DLR-driven APGD plus a targeted top-$k$ cascade reused from AutoAttack, with custom denominator (sort gap $z_{(1)}-0.5z_{(3)}-0.5z_{(4)}$) and per-sample best tracking — neither FGSM, PGD, MI-FGSM, nor stock AutoAttack uses these compound losses or schedule.

name: Restart PGD with CE/DLR alternation
tagline: 6 random restarts × 50-step momentum-PGD that alternates CE and DLR per step, $\alpha=\epsilon/4$, picks the per-sample lowest CE-margin adversarial.

key_hyperparams.name: warm restart jitter
key_hyperparams.role: init noise around best_adv after r=1

init_recovers: PGD baseline when all restarts use CE only and decay=0
diff_from_baseline: Augments PGD baseline with 6 random restarts, MI-FGSM-style normalized momentum, and a CE/DLR alternation per step (DLR is borrowed from AutoAttack's APGD-DLR), which neither vanilla PGD, MI-FGSM, nor FGSM does, and uses a per-sample margin-based best selection.
